question:
Smriti Mandhana is associated with which of the following sports?

[SSC GD 2025]
options: Cricket
Hockey
Wrestling
Badminton
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Cricket

Explanation:
Smriti Mandhana is a prominent player in the Indian women's cricket team. She is known as a left-handed opening batter and has set several records in international cricket. Smriti made her international debut in 2013 and has since been a crucial part of the Indian team. She was nominated as the ICC Women's Cricketer of the Year in 2018 and 2021.

Extra Facts:
Smriti Mandhana has also captained the Royal Challengers Bangalore (RCB) in the Women's Premier League (WPL). She delivered an outstanding performance in the inaugural season of WPL in 2023. Smriti was honored with the Arjuna Award in 2019. She is one of the highest run-scorers in Indian women's cricket.

question:
In tennis, what is a 'love' score?

[SSC MTS 2024]
options: The score when the game is tied
The highest possible score in a game
The score when a player has zero points
The score when a player wins the first point in a game
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is The score when a player has zero points

Explanation:
In tennis, the term 'love' is used to indicate that a player has zero (0) points. For example, if a player has not scored any points and the score is 15-0, it is called "15-love". The term originates from the French word 'l'oeuf', meaning 'egg', symbolizing the shape of zero. This is a unique part of tennis scoring and is often considered confusing for new players.

Extra Facts:
The tennis scoring system is different from other sports. In a game, the scores are 0 (love), 15, 30, 40, and then game. If the score reaches 40-40, it is called 'deuce'. After this, a player must win two consecutive points to win the game. Tennis matches are played in sets, and sets are divided into games.

☛ Serena Williams - Holds the record for most Grand Slam titles (23) in women's tennis
☛ Golden Slam - Winning all four Grand Slams and Olympic gold in the same year (Steffi Graf, 1988)

question_hi:
टेनिस में, 'लव (love)' स्कोर क्या है?

[SSC MTS 2024]
options_hi: वह स्कोर जब खेल टाई होता है
किसी खेल में उच्चतम संभव स्कोर
वह स्कोर जब किसी खिलाड़ी के पाइंट शून्य होते हैं
वह स्कोर जब कोई खिलाड़ी खेल में पहला पाइंट जीतता है
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है वह स्कोर जब किसी खिलाड़ी के पाइंट शून्य होते हैं

Explanation:
टेनिस में, 'लव (love)' शब्द का उपयोग तब किया जाता है जब किसी खिलाड़ी के पास शून्य (0) पाइंट होते हैं। उदाहरण के लिए, यदि एक खिलाड़ी ने कोई पाइंट नहीं जीता है और स्कोर 15-0 है, तो इसे "15-लव" कहा जाता है। यह शब्द फ्रेंच शब्द 'l'oeuf' से आया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'अंडा', जो शून्य के आकार का प्रतीक है। यह टेनिस स्कोरिंग सिस्टम का एक अनूठा हिस्सा है और इसे अक्सर नए खिलाड़ियों के लिए भ्रमित करने वाला माना जाता है।

Extra Facts:
टेनिस की स्कोरिंग प्रणाली अन्य खेलों से अलग है। एक गेम में स्कोर 0 (लव), 15, 30, 40 और फिर गेम होता है। यदि स्कोर 40-40 हो जाता है, तो इसे 'ड्यूस' कहा जाता है। इसके बाद, एक खिलाड़ी को दो लगातार पाइंट जीतने होंगे तभी वह गेम जीत सकता है। टेनिस में मैच सेट्स में खेला जाता है, और सेट्स गेम्स में बंटे होते हैं।

Important Points:
☛ ग्रैंड स्लैम - टेनिस के चार प्रमुख टूर्नामेंट (ऑस्ट्रेलियन ओपन, फ्रेंच ओपन, विंबलडन, यूएस ओपन)
☛ रोजर फेडरर - पुरुषों के टेनिस में सर्वाधिक ग्रैंड स्लैम (20) जीतने वाले खिलाड़ी
☛ सेरेना विलियम्स - महिलाओं के टेनिस में सर्वाधिक ग्रैंड स्लैम (23) जीतने वाली खिलाड़ी
☛ गोल्डन स्लैम - एक ही वर्ष में चारों ग्रैंड स्लैम और ओलंपिक गोल्ड जीतना (स्टेफी ग्राफ, 1988)
☛ विंबलडन - सबसे पुराना टेनिस टूर्नामेंट (1877 से आयोजित)

question:
The height of stumps in cricket is______

[SSC CGL 2022]
options: 28 inches
20 inches
25 inches
22 inches
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 28 inches

Explanation:
In cricket, the height of the stumps is 28 inches, as standardized by the International Cricket Council (ICC). The stumps consist of three wooden poles fixed into the ground and connected by bails. This height is set to ensure a fair challenge for bowlers to hit the wickets and for batsmen to judge the ball's trajectory accurately. The dimensions are crucial for maintaining uniformity in the game globally.

Extra Facts:
The width of cricket stumps is 9 inches, with each stump spaced 1.22 inches apart. They are typically made of bamboo or ash wood. ICC strictly regulates stump dimensions to ensure consistency across all matches. Modern stumps often have LED lights for visibility in day-night matches.

question:
Indian athlete Neeraj Chopra created history by becoming the first Indian to get gold in a world athletics championship. What was his sport?

[RRB ALP ]
options: Shot put
Javelin throw
Long jump
Discus throw
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Javelin throw

Explanation:
Neeraj Chopra made history by winning gold in Javelin Throw at the 2023 World Athletics Championships with a throw of 88.17 meters. Extra Facts:
Neeraj Chopra was born on December 24, 1997, in Panipat, Haryana. He first gained international recognition by winning gold at the 2016 World Junior Championships. His coach, Uwe Hohn (Germany), played a key role in refining his technique. Neeraj also won gold in the 2022 Diamond League.

question_hi:

लम्बी कूद

question:
Which is the oldest tennis tournament in the world?

[SSC MTS 2022]
options: French Ope
US Ope
Wimbledo
Australian Ope
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Wimbledon

Explanation:
Wimbledon is the oldest tennis tournament in the world, established in 1877. It is the only Grand Slam played on grass courts and is held at the All England Club in London. It is considered the most prestigious tournament in tennis history.

Extra Facts:
Wimbledon is also called "The Championships". It was the first tournament to introduce women's singles and men's doubles in 1884. In 1968, it became the first Open Era Grand Slam, allowing both professionals and amateurs to compete. The Centre Court at Wimbledon is one of the most iconic tennis venues globally.

विंबलडन दुनिया का सबसे पुराना टेनिस टूर्नामेंट है, जिसकी शुरुआत 1877 में हुई थी। यह लॉन टेनिस पर खेला जाने वाला एकमात्र ग्रैंड स्लैम टूर्नामेंट है और इसे ऑल इंग्लैंड क्लब, लंदन में आयोजित किया जाता है। विंबलडन की खासियत इसकी परंपराएं हैं, जैसे सफेद ड्रेस कोड, स्ट्रॉबेरी और क्रीम का सेवन, और रॉयल बॉक्स में शाही परिवार की उपस्थिति। यह टूर्नामेंट टेनिस इतिहास और संस्कृति का प्रतीक माना जाता है।

question:
How many points are awarded for Lona in Kabaddi?

[SSC GD 2025]
options: Two
Three
Four
Five
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Two

Explanation:
In Kabaddi, Lona is a significant term. When a team gets all the opposing team members out, it is called a Lona, and the team is awarded 2 points. This rule applies in both Pro Kabaddi League (PKL) and international Kabaddi. Apart from Lona, other scoring methods in Kabaddi include Touch Point (1 point) and All-Out (2 points).

Extra Facts:
Kabaddi is a traditional Indian sport that was included as a demonstration sport in the 1936 Berlin Olympics. The International Kabaddi Federation (IKF) was established in 2004. The Pro Kabaddi League (PKL) started in 2014 and played a crucial role in popularizing Kabaddi in India.

पारी/इनिंग शब्द का प्रयोग खो खो खेल में किया जाता है। यह एक पारंपरिक भारतीय खेल है जिसमें दो टीमें होती हैं और प्रत्येक टीम को एक पारी (inning) मिलती है। एक पारी में, एक टीम खोजने (चेज़र) और दूसरी टीम बचने (रनर) की भूमिका निभाती है। प्रत्येक पारी में टीम को अधिकतम अंक प्राप्त करने का मौका मिलता है। इनिंग शब्द का उपयोग क्रिकेट और बेसबॉल जैसे खेलों में भी होता है, लेकिन दिए गए विकल्पों में यह खो खो से संबंधित है।

question:
In Football a direct ______ is awarded if a player commits any of the following offences against an opponent in a manner considered by the referee to be careless, reckless or using excessive force:

[SSC GD 2024]
options: head kick
court kick
free kick
hat trick
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is free kick

Explanation:
In football, when a player commits an offence against an opponent in a manner considered by the referee to be careless, reckless, or using excessive force, a direct free kick is awarded. This is as per FIFA's Laws of the Game and includes fouls, pushing, handling the ball, or other illegal actions. A direct free kick allows a goal to be scored directly, whereas an indirect free kick requires another player to touch the ball first.

Extra Facts:
There are two types of free kicks - direct and indirect. A direct free kick can result in a goal directly, while an indirect one cannot. A penalty kick is a type of direct free kick awarded for fouls inside the penalty area.

Important Points:
☛ FIFA - The international governing body of football
☛ Penalty Kick - Taken from 12 yards, involving only the goalkeeper and the kicker
☛ Indirect Free Kick - Requires another player to touch the ball before a goal can be scored
☛ Red Card - Given for serious fouls or violent conduct
☛ Yellow Card - Issued as a caution for unsporting behavior
question_hi:
फुटबॉल में यदि कोई खिलाड़ी किसी प्रतिद्वंद्वी के खिलाफ निम्नलिखित में से कोई भी अपराध करता है, जिसे रेफरी लापरवाह, जोखिम या अत्यधिक बल का उपयोग करने वाला मानता है, तो सीधे ______ प्रदान की जाती है:

कोर्ट किक
फ्री किक
हैट ट्रिक
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है फ्री किक

Explanation:
फुटबॉल में, जब कोई खिलाड़ी प्रतिद्वंद्वी के खिलाफ लापरवाही, जोखिम भरा या अत्यधिक बल का उपयोग करता है, तो रेफरी द्वारा डायरेक्ट फ्री किक (Direct Free Kick) दी जाती है। यह नियम फीफा (FIFA) के नियमों के अनुसार है और इसमें फाउल, धक्का, हाथ से बॉल को छूना, या अन्य अवैध तरीके शामिल हैं। डायरेक्ट फ्री किक से सीधे गोल किया जा सकता है, जबकि इनडायरेक्ट फ्री किक में दूसरे खिलाड़ी को बॉल छूनी पड़ती है।

Extra Facts:

question:
In which of the following sports is the shakehand grip used?

[SSC CGL 2020]
options: Badminto
Squash
Cricket
Table tennis

Explanation:
The shakehand grip is a primary grip used in table tennis. In this grip, the player holds the racket similarly to how one shakes hands with another person. This grip is popular in European style play and allows for better control and power while using the racket. It differs from the penhold grip, which is more common in Asian countries. Players using the shakehand grip can easily execute both forehand and backhand strokes.

Extra Facts:
Table tennis is also known as ping pong and is an Olympic sport. The game is played using a racket and a plastic ball. It originated in 19th century England. Today, China dominates the sport, having won most of the World Championships.

question:
In Table Tennis, how many lets are allowed in a row on a serve?

[SSC CGL 2022]
options: Three
Unlimited
Two
One
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Unlimited

Explanation:
In Table Tennis, there is no limit to the number of lets allowed in a row on a serve. A let occurs when the serve touches the net but still lands correctly in the opponent's court or if the opponent is not ready to receive the serve. According to ITTF (International Table Tennis Federation) rules, lets can happen unlimited times, and the serve is retaken until it is legally executed or a point is scored.

Extra Facts:
Table Tennis, also known as Ping Pong, is an Olympic sport. The ITTF was founded in 1926 and is headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland. China dominates the sport, and matches are played under the rally system (11 points).

Important Points:
☛ ITTF - Founded in 1926 (Governing body of Table Tennis)
☛ Olympic Table Tennis - Introduced in 1988
☛ Serve Rules - Ball must be tossed at least 16 cm vertically
☛ Match Format - Best of 5 or 7 games
☛ India's Top Player - Sharath Kamal (Commonwealth Games gold medalist)

question:
A new cricket ball shall weigh not less than 155.9 g, nor more than _______ g, for standard conditions.

[SSC GD 2025]
options: 161
162
163
164
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 163

Explanation:
The weight of a cricket ball is regulated by the International Cricket Council (ICC). A new cricket ball must weigh no less than 155.9 grams and no more than 163 grams. This rule applies to Test matches and One-Day Internationals (ODIs). The weight of the ball is crucial to maintain fairness and balance during the game. Hence, the correct answer is 163 grams.

Extra Facts:
Cricket balls are made of leather and stitched in two halves. Red balls are used in Test matches, while white balls are used in limited-overs matches (e.g., ODIs and T20s). The weight and size of the ball are standardized based on the match format.

Important Points:
☛ Circumference of a cricket ball - 22.4 to 22.9 cm (for men)
